headline: Google Executive Leaves SpaceX Board as Musk Cites Alphabet Conflicts
summary: A Google executive has departed the board of directors of SpaceX after Elon Musk highlighted operational conflicts of interest with parent company Alphabet.
why: SpaceX is a leading aerospace defense contractor and satellite operator, while Alphabet is a major technology conglomerate with overlapping AI and satellite interests.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: The exit reflects governance tensions between the major tech conglomerate and Musk's private venture.
